verdict.rationale: The skills CLI documents real bulk operations in a single command. You can install every skill in a repo with '*', pass multiple --skill and -a flags to install many skills across many agents at once, and run update with no args or several names. Removal can target multiple agents at once, and a whole skill set can be restored from skills-lock.json, all in a CI-friendly non-interactive mode. missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of bulk install/update runs (the runtime probe only exercised --list and non-interactive detection), and documented bulk removal of multiple skills in one command (the remove example covers multiple agents but a single skill).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Install specific skills by name (use `'*'` for all skills)
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design --skill skill-creator
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills -a claude-code -a opencode
npx skills remove --agent claude-code cursor my-skill
